about.en: TKO (Toko Token) is the utility token of Tokocrypto, an Indonesian crypto exchange registered with the country's regulators and part of the Binance group, used for trading-fee discounts, rewards and ecosystem services. It is a BEP-20 on BNB Smart Chain at 0x9f589e3eabe42ebc94a44727b3f3531c0c877809, launched through Binance Launchpad in 2021.
